name: Henry Nessle
background: Henry Nessul, also listed as Henry Nessle, of Weston County ran in Republican primaries for county commissioner and lost, including the August 2026 primary. The News Letter Journal reported that he finished last in that seven-candidate primary with 283 votes. No public-record occupation, education, or military service was found in the official Weston County election results or the other public records reviewed for this Profile.

sources.name: News Letter Journal, Weston County certifies 2026 primary results
